title: Actions and functions
explain: Bound/unbound actions extend CRUD with domain operations. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "Actions and functions" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without Actions and functions, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of Actions and functions without a failure story
howToApply: Use Actions and functions explicitly in a design defense sentence
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “Actions and functions” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (Actions → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Discount approval near S/4 — choose placement using Actions and functions without core mods.
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “Actions and functions” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “Actions and functions”.
